description: F5: a `struct` type name colliding with the Geometry overlay primitive `axes` raises `ol-reserved-word` at phase-1 registration. Issue #403; byte-identical in `code`/`params` to what `check()` reports for the same program (`spec/error-model.md:125`). Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.

diagnostics.message: axes is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
